outcomes.question: Raiders vs. Patriots: 3Q O/U 6.5

raw_market.question: Raiders vs. Patriots: 3Q O/U 6.5
raw_market.description:
In the third quarter of the NFL game between Raiders and Patriots, scheduled for October 11 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Raiders and Patriots combine to score 7 or more points in the third quarter.

If the combined third quarter total is less than 7, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
